minutes_text:
LA VERNE YOUTH & FAMILY ACTION COMMITTEE
  Minutes of the Regular Meeting
  May 28, 2019
1. A regular meeting of the Youth & Family Action Committee was called to order by
  Mayor Don Kendrick at 6:30 p.m.

2. Executive Board Members present:

  Executive Board
  Don Kendrick, Mayor
  Robin Carder, Council Member
  Matthew Lyons, BUSD
  Carolyn Cockrell, BUSD
  Ernie Dorado, Resident

  Mark Rodgers, BUSD
  Patti Latourelle, Resident
  Denise Fisher, Resident
  Jason Lorge, Resident
  Morgan Kostolefsky, Resident
  Hollie Savage, LVPD
  Francisco Cambero, LVPD
  David Yim, Tri-City
  Isela Moreno, Tri-City
  Bill Aguirre, City of La Verne
  JR Ranells, City of La Verne

3. Review of Minutes  Minutes for the April meeting were approved.

4. School Resource Officer  School Resource Officer (SRO) Frankie Cambero
  noted that the school year was wrapping up with
  good byes and some anxious students. The group
  discussed opportunities and strategies to mitigate
  continued concerns surrounding vaping. There was
  also discussion involving mental health issues. It
  was suggested that a subcommittee involving the
  Police Department and BUSD representatives be
  created in order to discuss best avenues to educate
  students of these concerns toward the beginning of
  the school year.

5. Leadership Program  Bill Aguirre with the City of La Verne presented the
  idea of establishing a $250 scholarship for youth that
  give back to YFAC as participants. Mayor Kendrick
  had originally requested this be established. The
  group approved the concept and voted to award
  Vanessa Hess the first scholarship.
 Youth & Family Action Committee Minutes May 28, 2019, page 2

6. Mentor Program  Carolyn Cockrell with the BUSD and the coordinator of
  the Mentor Program provided a recap of the spring
  semester’s program. Carolyn noted that they had
  great participants this semester and that positive
  connections had been made.

7. Community Navigator  Community Navigator Isela Moreno reported on the
  regular availability of navigators in La Verne. Isela
  also noted that navigators had been assisting local
  homeless persons with services and has been
  partnering with the Police Department through the
  HOST program regularly.

8. Video Updates  JR Ranells with the City of La Verne shared the
  Summer Lunch video that had been created and put
  out on social media earlier in the month. JR also
  reported that the video on Mental Health was
  underway and would be posted prior to the August
  meeting. Patti Latourelle noted that the statistical
  results of the videos should be shared with the group.

9. Round Table  SRO Cambero thanked the group for their part in the
  successful POA Golf Tournament whose proceeds will
  be going toward YFAC programs. The final numbers
  are being counted and will be shared with the group at
  the next meeting.

  Mark Rodgers with the BUSD shared information on a
  Parent Academy taking place in October at Lone Hill
  Elementary. The BUSD is expecting 100-150
  participants.

  Denise Fisher provided information on the efforts of
  the newly created committee to support a La Verne K9
  and associated vehicle.

10.  Next Meeting  The next YFAC meeting is scheduled for August 27,
  2019 at 6:30 p.m.

11. Adjournment  The meeting was adjourned at 8:15 p.m.

Respectfully submitted,

JR Ranells
Personnel Officer
